questions.question: What does God command Moses to take at the start of Numbers?
options: A sacrifice at the tent of meeting
A long march toward the promised land
An offering of gold from each tribe
A census of the men able to fight
questions.answer: A census of the men able to fight

questions.question: Which tribe was not counted in the military census, but set apart for the tabernacle?
The Levites were assigned to care for the tabernacle.
Moses counted the men twenty years old and upward who could serve in Israel's _____.
The tribe of _____ was not numbered with the others, but set apart for the tent.
